name: review-gate
description: Reviews a branch before its pull request with parallel reviewer agents and checkers that vote, keeps every finding until it is fixed or dismissed with a reason, and opens and merges the pull request only for the reviewed commit.

depth.title: Review depth
depth.description: How many reviewers and checkers a round runs. auto picks by the risk a classifier reads from the change: quick for low, standard for medium, deep for high.

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: The model the reviewer and checker agents run on. inherit uses the session's model.

riskModel.title: Risk model
riskModel.description: The model that judges a change's risk before each round. inherit uses the reviewer model.
